prompt_text: I want to try a tanning salon in Charlotte. Which specific salons should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — first, a quick question so I give the best recommendations: do you want a UV tanning bed (indoor sunbeds) or a spray/airbrush tan? And what part of Charlotte are you near (zip code or neighborhood: Uptown, South End, Ballantyne, etc.)?

If you want to decide now, here’s a practical plan for which places to call and why, plus a short script and what to compare when they answer.

Which specific places to call (call 3–5, covering these types)
- A national chain (e.g., Palm Beach Tan or another recognizable chain) — why: consistent pricing, standard equipment, membership options, multiple Charlotte locations so you can pick the most convenient one and often get first-visit specials.
- A high-end salon that advertises newer tanning beds and/or red-light/LED options (look for brands like Ergoline, KBL, or Tan Systems) — why: newer beds often give better, faster results and are better maintained; these salons often provide skin consultations and higher-end lotions.
- A boutique spray-tan studio (airbrush or Mystic/Norvell franchises) — why: if you want an even, safer tan without UV exposure, a boutique studio with certified technicians will usually give more natural results than automated booths.
- A nearby gym or convenience tanning salon (if convenience/price is your main concern) — why: cheaper drop-in options and often convenient hours; ask about bulb age and maintenance.
- One highly-rated local salon (look for 4+ star reviews on Google/Yelp) — why: independent salons often have experienced techs and personalized service.

What to ask when you call (use this to compare)
- Do you offer UV tanning beds, spray/airbrush tanning, or both?
- If UV: what bed brands/models do you have, and how old are the bulbs? (Newer Ergoline/KBL/Tan Systems beds are a plus.)
- If spray: is it manual airbrush or automated booth? Are technicians certified? Can I see before/after photos?
- Do you offer a first-time client special or package rates?
- Do you provide a skin-type consultation and a suggested schedule for sessions?
- What lotions/accelerators do you use and are they included?
- What are your sanitation/cleaning procedures between clients?
- Do you require or recommend a patch test for spray tan?
- How long should I wait after a spray tan before showering or exercising?
- Any contraindications or safety guidance (especially if pregnant, taking photosensitizing meds, or having a skin condition)?

Quick phone script
“Hi — I’m a first-time client and considering a (UV bed / spray tan). Do you have availability for a consultation or first session? Also, what first-time specials do you offer and what type of equipment/technicians do you use?”

How to choose after calls
- Prioritize safety and transparency: if staff can’t answer bed brands, bulb age, or cleaning protocols, be cautious.
- For UV tanning: prefer salons that offer skin type consultations, newer beds, and short recommended session times.
- For spray: prefer manual (airbrush) or certified technicians and positive before/after photos.
- Price: expect to pay more for boutique or high-end services; chains often have the best deals for repeat users.

If you want, tell me:
- UV or spray?
- Neighborhood or zip code in Charlotte?
I’ll look up and list 3–5 specific salons to call (with short reasons for each).
